description: This file defines the 'dbus' package with functions and types for handling D-Bus method calls, signals, error handling, and object exporting in a Go implementation. It includes error definitions, method reflection, call handling, and object export mechanisms.

methods.name: MakeNoObjectError
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating no such object exists at the given ObjectPath.

methods.name: MakeUnknownMethodError
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating an unknown or invalid method name.

methods.name: MakeUnknownInterfaceError
methods.description: Creates an Error indicating an object does not implement the specified interface.

methods.name: MakeFailedError
methods.description: Wraps a generic error into a D-Bus Error with 'Failed' code.

methods.name: computeMethodName
methods.description: Computes the method name, remapping if a mapping is provided.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves a map of method names to reflect.Values for an object, considering method signatures and visibility.

methods.name: getAllMethods
methods.description: Retrieves all methods of an object, with optional name remapping.

methods.name: standardMethodArgumentDecode
methods.description: Decodes method arguments from a message body, handling special types Sender and Message.
